format: Parquet exchange table; timestamps require timezone contract

required_provenance.known_at: verified first release or null; never ingestion backdated
required_provenance.source_observed_at: actual observation UTC or offset timestamp

fields.entry: actual first filled next open or null
fields.exit: actual filled open or verified terminal cash endpoint
fields.value: return or null, never fill missing with zero

null_policy: unknown is null with explicit reason; no synthetic zeros
publication_rule: date only becomes available next verified session open
